name: half kneeling side lunge
description: From a half kneeling position you shift your weight sideways to open the hips and inner thigh. It builds hip mobility.
instructions: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg straight out to the side with its foot on the floor.
Keep your torso tall and shift your hips gently toward the straight leg, letting the planted knee bend as needed.
Stop when you feel a comfortable stretch through the inner thigh of the extended leg.
Shift back to center, repeat, then switch sides.
